```yaml
name: CI Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'agents-docs/**'
      - 'packages/agents-core/src/**'
      - 'agents-cli/src/**'
      - 'agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'agents-docs/**'
      - 'packages/agents-core/src/**'
      - 'agents-cli/src/**'
      - 'agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'  # Monday 6am UTC

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-docs-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-docs:
    name: Build, lint, typecheck agents-docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build, lint, typecheck agents-docs
        run: npx turbo run build lint typecheck --filter=@inkeep/agents-docs
```
